name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji's fascination with motorsport began in his childhood, spending countless hours tinkering with model cars and watching Formula 1 races with his father. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where he excelled in courses related to materials science and manufacturing processes. His final year project, a novel suspension system design, caught the attention of Akkodis ASP Team scouts.

Joining Akkodis ASP Team as a fabricator, Kenji quickly demonstrated his meticulous attention to detail and exceptional problem-solving skills. He approaches every task, from welding chassis components to crafting intricate aerodynamic parts, with unwavering precision and a commitment to quality. Kenji's dedication to pushing the boundaries of what's possible, combined with his innate understanding of vehicle dynamics, makes him an invaluable asset to the team.

While his ambition is clear, Kenji is known for his independent working style. He thrives in environments where he can focus deeply on complex tasks, often preferring to work alone to maximize his productivity. This independent streak, combined with his sharp technical mind, sets him apart as a rising star in motorsport fabrication.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Kenji is of average height, with a wiry build honed from long hours in the garage.

quirks: Always wears noise-canceling headphones while working, regardless of the noise level.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on metal surfaces to test their resonance.
Keeps a small origami crane on his workbench as a good luck charm.
